dataset: USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy April 2018
recordHashRule: SHA256 UTF8 JSON {food:rawFoodRow,nutrients:rawNutrientRows}, recursively sorted object keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false
dataRights: USDA federal food composition reference data; retain source attribution. No third-party recipe/photo rights implied.

nutrientBasis.1005: total carbohydrate by difference g/100g; includes dietary fibre
nutrientBasis.1008: source declared energy kcal/100g; may use food-specific factors unlike current app engine

cautions: Generic USDA food profiles are not laboratory tests of the actual brand.
Carbohydrate by difference includes fibre; do not subtract fibre twice.
Do not substitute CoFID monosaccharide-equivalent carbohydrate in this method.
Existing keto-engine default energy method may differ from USDA source energy; both retained for editorial review.
Weights in new candidate recipes are proposed independent formulations, never conversions of old piece/spoon counts.
